system.name: WONDERBREAD
system.one_liner: A benchmark of 2,928 documented web workflow demonstrations and 6 business-process-management tasks for evaluating multimodal foundation models.

content.variant_note: three numbered columns (dataset, benchmark tasks, evaluation); the second and third hold three tinted rows, each a small inputs, model, output chain
content.argues: WONDERBREAD has three parts: demonstrations with recording, action trace and written guide; tasks that go beyond automation; and automatic graders for every task.
content.subject: Anatomy of one demonstration, three task rows that feed a Multimodal FM, and three evaluation rows graded by GPT4 or programmatic metrics.

lessons.what_to_learn: State a benchmark as numbered columns that match the caption (dataset, tasks, evaluation); zoom one record out of a card stack with a wedge and split it with plus signs, and draw every task as the same chain: inputs in big parentheses, a labelled block arrow for the model, then the output.
lessons.suits: benchmarks that bundle a dataset, several tasks and automatic graders and need one figure showing the data, the task format and the metrics.

evidence: (1) We curate 2928 human demonstrations across 598 web navigation tasks.
(2) We create 6 BPM tasks that measure a model’s ability to generate accurate documentation,
(3) We provide automated evaluation pipelines for all tasks.

summary: WONDERBREAD is a benchmark for evaluating multimodal foundation models on business process management tasks beyond automation. Figure 1 shows its three components as numbered columns. Column 1 stacks 2,928 workflow demonstrations (598 workflows, 162 rankings, 4 websites) and opens Demo 3 with a wedge into intent, screen recording, action trace and SOP. Column 2 has three tinted rows (Documentation, Knowledge Transfer, Improvement), each a tuple of inputs in parentheses, a pink Multimodal FM block arrow and an output. Column 3 has Rubric-Based and Pairwise SOPs rows graded by a blue GPT4 arrow, and a Programmatic row of clustering, classification and correlation thumbnails.
summary_zh: WONDERBREAD 用于评测多模态基础模型在业务流程管理任务上的能力。图 1 分三列：数据集（演示堆叠并放大 Demo 3）、基准任务（文档、知识迁移、改进三行）、评测（量表、成对 SOP、程序化指标）。
notes: The caption speaks of 6 tasks but the figure draws three task rows; how the six map onto the rows is not shown. Evaluation rows are not colour-linked to the task rows they grade. The Rubric and Grades cards hold 1 pt text lines (for example a best-selling-product question and a click guide) that read as texture. Prior labels kept in order: contribution-mosaic first as a deliverables triptych, stage-pipeline for the rows, scope-overview for the dataset statistics.
